title: Evolution 5
author: Mobius2025
selftext:
This is version 5 of the web application, containing many changes from prior versions, based on feedback and some clarifications regarding the process of biological evolution that I wanted to be included. There are still some places where the evolutionary process from one living being to a later one are not shown, but that could be due to gaps in our current scientific knowledge and/or understanding.
